name: Incremental Bubble-Sort A-Buffer Blending
definition: An alternative blending technique that relies on the transparency component of generated brush strokes, controlled by adjusting amplitude, σx, and σy values of Gaussians. It simulates tint blending by applying common alpha blending on rendered patches with stronger influence for topmost patches.
summary: Incremental Bubble-Sort A-Buffer Blending is a hardware-accelerated compositing technique that maintains real-time interactivity by dividing bubble-sort execution across multiple frames.
